command: Isolated disposable macOS HOME using the exact v1.0.10 tagged binary; setup against loopback Ollama and one headless local turn with cloud HTTP proxies directed to closed loopback port 9, followed by a deliberately missing Ollama model

No credential field was written; the Ollama provider section contained only type and loopback base_url.
Standard setup selected ollama/qwen2.5:0.5b from live capability metadata without manual config editing.
With cloud proxies closed, the harmless local turn returned UAT_OK with exit 0 and zero tool calls.
Missing model returned exit 4, JARN-MODEL-001, /model refresh plus Ollama pull/tool-capability remediation, and no Done or Ready success text.
result: Exact v1.0.10 binary discovered the loopback Ollama endpoint, selected the sole tool-capable model with a keyless local provider, completed a cloud-offline local turn, and rejected an unavailable model with stable actionable remediation.
limitations: This is a truthful local equivalent of the SSH-first harness on the current macOS host; scripts/uat/uat-005-ollama.sh --execute was not invoked because it requires a separate disposable SSH target and interactive confirmation.
